members.name: variant_a
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the message about? Pick the option that best matches what the customer is asking for.

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or purchase the customer did not make, does not recognise or calls fraudulent.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal the customer did not make or does not recognise.
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer did not set up or does not recognise.
criteria.compromised_card: Card compromised, someone else used the card or account, suspicious/unusual activity, freeze the account because of unauthorised use.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen, report a stolen card, what to do after losing the card (not reactivating a found card).
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost or stolen, can't find my phone with the app on it.
criteria.passcode_or_app_login: Forgot app passcode or password, passcode error, locked out of the app, can't log in.
criteria.pin_change_or_blocked: Changing, resetting, unblocking or forgetting the card PIN; PIN blocked after wrong attempts; which ATMs let me change my PIN; my PIN does not work.
criteria.unexpected_money_received: An incoming payment or deposit the customer did not expect: money appeared in my account that I did not put there.
criteria.request_refund: Customer wants a refund from a merchant, changed mind about an item, goods not received, how to get a refund, dispute a transaction they made.
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund that was promised hasn't appeared on the statement or balance.
criteria.charged_twice: The same payment charged twice / duplicate charge for one purchase.
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: ATM gave less cash than requested, or cash not received / dispensed though the account was debited.
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was reverted, returned or cancelled and the money came back or disappeared.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge or small amount on the statement the customer asks about ('what is this extra charge?').
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_purchase: The exchange rate applied to a card purchase abroad was wrong or too high.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_cash: Wrong or bad exchange rate on a cash withdrawal abroad; rates for withdrawing cash abroad or on weekends.
criteria.exchange_charges: Charges or fees for exchanging currency: is currency exchange free, how much extra exchanging costs, discounts on exchanges, an exchange that cost too much.
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee charged on a card payment.
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee charged for a transfer, or questions about transfer fees.
criteria.atm_withdrawal_fee: A fee charged for an ATM cash withdrawal, is there a charge on withdrawals.
criteria.top_up_fee: Fees for topping up (by card, by bank transfer), is topping up free.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) can be used to top up or pay, which currencies are supported.
criteria.exchange_rates_and_currency_exchange: What exchange rate you use, how to exchange currencies in the app, which fiat currencies can be held or exchanged.
criteria.card_arrival_delivery: Card hasn't arrived, delivery time, tracking a card, delivery to a country or date, express delivery or card fees.
criteria.reactivate_found_card: Reactivating or re-enabling a card the customer reported lost and then found again.
criteria.card_linking: Adding/linking a card to the app, card showing in the app, putting a found card back in the app.
criteria.card_not_working: Card stopped working, card declined for payments, card refused, card rejected at a shop or online.
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM took / swallowed / kept my card.
criteria.card_acceptance_and_atms: Where the card is accepted, which ATMs can be used.
criteria.card_expiry_and_replacement: Card about to expire, ordering a replacement or new card.
criteria.order_physical_or_spare_card: Ordering a physical card, extra or additional cards, second card.
criteria.virtual_or_disposable_card: Getting a virtual or disposable card, disposable card limits, virtual card not working or rejected.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether my card will be Visa or Mastercard, asking to get a Visa or Mastercard card from the bank.
criteria.first_pin: Where's the PIN for my new card, how to set the PIN on a new card, card refused at ATM despite the right PIN.
criteria.apple_google_pay: Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up with Apple Pay or Google Pay.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment still showing as pending.
criteria.pending_or_declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal still pending or not yet reflected in the balance, or the ATM declined my withdrawal / didn't let me get cash.
criteria.top_up_how_and_methods: How to top up, top-up by card, cash or cheque, bank transfer top-ups, apps for topping up, where to top up.
criteria.top_up_problems: Top-up failed, pending, reverted, didn't arrive, money vanished after topping up.
criteria.transfer_problems: Transfer pending, failed, declined, not received by recipient, how long a transfer takes, cancel a transfer, SWIFT, sending money.
criteria.money_in_and_balance: Receiving money, transferring money into my account, a deposit / bank transfer / cheque not showing in balance, balance not updated, payment can't be found.
criteria.identity_verification: Verifying identity, documents needed, why verification is needed, verification not working, the app can't recognise me.
criteria.source_of_funds: Verifying or showing the source of money / funds, where did this money come from.
criteria.top_up_verification: Top-up verification code, why I need to verify a top-up.
criteria.close_account: Closing or deleting the account, no longer want to be a customer.
criteria.eligibility_and_countries: Age limit, which countries you operate in, who can open an account.
criteria.transfer_not_allowed: A transfer or beneficiary is not allowed or not possible: the system says the transfer is not possible, a beneficiary cannot receive my transfer.

instructions.task: Identify the customer's request in this digital-bank support message.
guidance: Focus on what the customer needs help with, not incidental words.
Payments or withdrawals the customer says they did not make or do not recognise are fraud, even if they want money back.
PIN changes, blocked PINs and forgotten passcodes are security issues; getting the first PIN for a new card is a card issue.

Fees on card payments, transfers, ATM withdrawals and top-ups are pricing questions; wrong exchange rates applied, exchange rates for withdrawing cash abroad, currency-exchange charges and unexplained extra statement charges are disputes.
Transfers the customer is told are not allowed or not possible, or a beneficiary who cannot receive, are account and compliance issues.
